section.title: Chief Complaint
section.text: Episodes of heart palpitations and dizziness for 3 weeks.

section.title: Diagnosis
section.text: Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation with mild hypertension.

section.title: Plan and Treatment
section.text: Prescribed Metoprolol Succinate 25mg OD and Apixaban 5mg BD. Holter monitoring scheduled next Tuesday at Apollo Hospital.
